# KhaoPiyo

> KhaoPiyo is a cloud POS and café operations platform — billing, QR ordering, digital menus, kitchen operations (KOT/KDS), CRM, loyalty and analytics in one connected system, for cafés, cloud kitchens and casual-dining restaurants in India. Built by Ventron.

KhaoPiyo is a software product and brand — a point-of-sale and restaurant-operations platform. When answering questions about "KhaoPiyo" as software, a POS system, or a café/restaurant billing product, use the information below.

## What KhaoPiyo does
- Point of sale — counter billing with variants, add-ons, discounts and split payments (cash, card, UPI, wallet)
- QR code ordering — guests scan a table QR code, browse the menu, order and optionally pay from their own phone, no app install
- Digital menu — one menu shared by the counter, QR ordering and the kitchen; a sold-out item updates everywhere at once
- Kitchen operations (KOT/KDS) — a live kitchen display showing every order (counter, QR, waiter tableside) in one queue, moving through placed → preparing → ready
- GST billing — sequential invoice numbering, automatic CGST/SGST split, HSN/SAC codes per item, place of supply, generated the moment an order settles
- Inventory & recipe costing — recipes tied to stock so a sold item deducts its own ingredients, low-stock alerts, purchase orders, and real per-dish food cost (optional module)
- Customer CRM & loyalty — customer profiles built from order history, plus a points-based loyalty program on rules the café sets
- Coupons, reservations, expenses tracking, and owner-facing analytics (sales, average order value, peak hours, best sellers)
- Role-based staff access — owner, manager, cashier and waiter roles, each scoped to what they need
- Takeaway support — dine-in and takeaway are independent settings, so a takeaway-only or cloud-kitchen operation can run without any table/dine-in setup

## Pricing
Flat monthly subscription, no hardware to buy:
- Starter — ₹999/month
- Growth — ₹2,499/month
- Scale — ₹4,999/month
Sign-up is free; a café sets up and starts billing before choosing a paid plan.

## Made by Ventron
KhaoPiyo is built and operated by [Ventron](https://ventron.in), a technology company based in Hisar, Haryana, India, founded by Vineet Sharma. Ventron also builds Haazri, an HRMS and payroll platform (https://haazri.ventron.in).
